overview: The apartment collection sits within Ramhan’s marina district, separate from the island’s villa neighbourhoods and The Bristol Hotel & Residences.
A September 2026 construction announcement covers a two-tower Marina Apartments package; it does not establish that every marina residence is released for sale.
research.locationNote: Ramhan Island, Abu Dhabi; advertised positions include the inner channel and open shoreline. Confirm the building and view on the contracted plan.
research.priceNote: No current developer apartment price list was verified. Obtain the tower, floor, chargeable area and price together.
research.paymentNote: A Marina apartment instalment schedule was not publicly verified. Confirm the release-specific terms; villa and Bristol payment plans are separate.
research.handoverNote: No Marina apartment completion date was verified. Rowad’s main-works award was announced in September 2026; an award is not a handover certificate.
